mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_intent_preference_correction_t( id, tenant_id, user_id, intent_access_name, session_id, source_message_id, source_type, query_text, preference_intent, original_intent, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{intentAccessName}, #{sessionId}, #{sourceMessageId}, #{sourceType}, #{queryText}, #{preferenceIntent}, #{originalIntent}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_id = EXCLUDED.session_id, source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type, query_text = EXCLUDED.query_text, preference_intent = EXCLUDED.preference_intent, original_intent = EXCLUDED.original_intent, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
